en.title: Lexicographically Smallest Permutation With the Maximum Weighted Sum
en.description:
Output a permutation p of 1..n that maximizes Σ i×data[p[i]−1], where i starts from 1. If the maximum is tied, choose the lexicographically smallest index permutation.

Standard input/output, examples and judging were written independently by CSWork; conventions marked as this site's do not claim to be the source's original limits.
en.input: The first line contains n (1..100000); the second line contains n positive integers (1..10⁹).
en.explanation: Example 1: the values in order are 1, 2, 2, and the two equal 2s are placed by original indices 1, 3, so the output is 2 1 3 with sum 11. Example 2: the only possible output is 1. Example 3: value 1 goes first, followed by indices 1, 2, so the output is 3 1 2.
hints: Order the indices by element value in ascending order; for equal values, order them by original index in ascending order.
